name: rudy-ios
description: Capacitor wrapper for the RUDY PWA — packages the existing web build (index.html + sw.js + assets) into a native iOS app for App Store distribution. Web app keeps living at GitHub Pages; this is the App Store track.

scripts.build:web: rm -rf www && mkdir www && cp index.html sw.js manifest.json version.json splash.mp4 icon-120.png icon-152.png icon-167.png icon-180.png icon-192.png icon-512.png www/
scripts.ios:add: npm run build:web && npx cap add ios
scripts.ios:sync: npm run build:web && npx cap sync ios
scripts.ios:build: npm run ios:sync && echo 'Open Xcode and run Product → Archive'
